name: Glass issue closed by a commit
oneLiner: an issue card on glass with its comment: a commit lands on the timeline, its closes #42 reference lights up, the rail runs green into a check node and the status pill flips from Open to Closed as the icon turns green
say: when the speaker says a bug or a request got fixed ('someone reported it on Monday and the agent closed it by lunch', 'that issue is closed'): the commit lands on 'fixed it', the pill flips on 'closed'
